datasets.name: CreditsInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   B.CREDITLINEAMOUNT
 , B.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE
 , B.ANNUALYOVERDUERATE
 , B.DATEOFCONCLUSION
 , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT
 , B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT
 , B.PURPOSEOFCREDIT
 , B.USRGROUP
 , B.CUSTOMERTYPE
 , B.CREDITTYPE
 , L.NAME
FROM
   CM_ACTIVE_CREDITS B
 , CM_BOOROWERINFO L
WHERE
     (B.ID =:CrdID)
 AND (L.CREDITID =:CrdID)

datasets.name: Tranches
datasets.sql:
select *from (
SELECT  creditid, tranchedate, trancheamount
  FROM cm_tranches
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID

union all
select id as creditid,dat tranchedate ,lammount trancheamount
 from provarch where id in(select komtrid from cm_tranches where CreditID=:CrdID)
 union all
select id as creditid,dat tranchedate ,lammount trancheamount
 from provarch where id in(select komcastrid from cm_tranches where CreditID=:CrdID)
 
 )a 
 order by creditid

datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira,  id ,
        creditid ,
        paydate , 
        payedamt , 
        payedintamt,
        payeddueamt,
       payeddueintamt, 
       payedpenaltyamt, advance,insurance,service,
    payedamt + 
        payedintamt+
        payeddueamt+
       payeddueintamt+ 
       payedpenaltyamt+advance+insurance+service as sm

  FROM cm_payments 
WHERE (CreditID=:CrdID)
order by paydate

datasets.name: Schedule
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum sira, id, creditid, paymentdate, rest,
    principal, 
    interest,advance,service,insurance,
    principal+interest as sm
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
 WHERE CreditID=:CrdID
order  by paymentdate

datasets.name: RestsInPeriod
datasets.sql:
SELECT h.hdate,
       h.rest,
       h.interestrest,
       abs(ar2.ostat) doublepaymentaccid,
       abs(ar.ostat)  insurance,
       abs(ar1.ostat) commisya,
       h.duerest,
       h.dueinterestrest,
       h.dueday,
       h.penaltyrest,
       NVL(h.interst_dueday, 0) interst_dueday
  FROM cm_history h, 
       cm_accounts a, 
       archost ar, 
       archost ar1,
       archost ar2
 WHERE h.creditid = a.creditid
   AND a.insuranceaccid = ar.acc_id(+)
   AND a.commissionobligationaccid = ar1.acc_id(+)
   AND a.doublepaymentaccid=ar2.acc_id(+)
   AND h.hdate = ar.datdate(+)
   AND h.hdate = ar1.datdate(+)
   AND h.hdate = ar2.datdate(+)
   AND h.creditid = :crdid
   AND h.hdate BETWEEN :D1 AND :D2
 ORDER BY h.hdate DESC

datasets.name: IntrInPeriod
datasets.sql:
SELECT  hdate,trunc(interest,2) interest, dueinterest,penaltyinterest
  FROM cm_interests
 WHERE creditid=:crdid 
   AND hdate between :D1 and :D2 
order by hdate desc

datasets.name: ReportDataSet
datasets.sql:
select  
        A.contractaccid,
        P.boorowerid,(select tek_dat from sysdat) dat,
        p.currency,
        P.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.creditlineamount,
        c.name,p.annualyinterestrate,
       c.inn,h.rest+h.duerest as rest,
        v.val_name ,h.interestrest+h.dueinterestrest intrest/*,
        
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.booroweraccid) as clientaccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.contractaccid) as contractacccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.interestaccid) as interestacccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.dueloanaccid) as dueloanaccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.dueinterestaccid) as dueinterestaccno,
        cm_common.accountnumber_get(A.loanaccid) as loanaccAccno*/
        
from  CM_ACCOUNTS A,
      cm_PORTFOLIO P,cm_curr_state h,
      customers c,
      avalute v     
where 
      (P.id = :CrdId)and 
      (A.creditid = P.id)and
      (c.id = p.boorowerid)and
      (v.valute = p.currency)  and
      (p.id=h.creditid)

datasets.name: DataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT rownum,-2, c.ID creditid, b.NAME user1, c.dateofconclusion hdate,
        c.insertdat sysdat, '' oldparam, 'KREDITI DAXIL EDEN' newparam,
        'Daxil edən' polya, 'USID' polyaen, 'CM_PORTFOLIO' tablename
   FROM cm_portfolio c, smart.user$ b
  WHERE c.ID = :id AND c.usid = b.ID
 union 
 SELECT rownum+1, -1, c.ID creditid, b.NAME user1, c.dateofconclusion hdate,
        c.postdate sysdat, '' oldparam, 'KREDITI TESDIQ EDEN' newparam,
        'Təsdiq edən' polya, 'POSTUSER' polyaen, 'CM_PORTFOLIO' tablename
   FROM cm_portfolio c, smart.user$ b
  WHERE c.ID = :id AND c.postuser = b.ID
 union 
 SELECT rownum+2, a.id, a.creditid, a.user1, a.hdate, a.sysdat, a.oldparam,
        a.newparam, a.polya, a.polyaen, a.tablename
   FROM cm_portfolio_update a
 where a.creditid=:id

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.creditid, a.hdate, a.enddat, a.interest, a.dueinterest,nvl(a.users,'SMART') users,
       a.status
  FROM cm_endcalac a where creditid=:creditid
and a.enddat in (SELECT max(enddat)
  FROM cm_endcalac  where creditid=:creditid)
